definitions.explanation: A previously owned automobile being resold, as opposed to a brand-new vehicle.

examples.japanese: {中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}を{買|か}った。
{中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}の{販売店|はんばいてん}で{試乗|しじょう}してきた。
examples.english: I went for a test drive at a used car dealership.

examples.japanese: {新車|しんしゃ}は{高|たか}いので、{状態|じょうたい}の{良|よ}い{中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}を{探|さが}すことにした。
examples.english: Since a new car is expensive, I decided to look for a used car in good condition.

notes:
A compound of {中古|ちゅうこ} (secondhand; used) and {車|しゃ} (car; vehicle). Japan has an especially large and well-organized used car market, with vehicles often in excellent condition due to the country's strict vehicle inspection system ({車検|しゃけん}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}{販売|はんばい}: used car sales
- {中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}{販売店|はんばいてん}: used car dealership
- {中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}{市場|しじょう}: used car market
- {中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}を{探|さが}す: to look for a used car
- {認定|にんてい}{中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}: certified pre-owned vehicle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新車|しんしゃ}: new car — the direct opposite
- {中古|ちゅうこ}: secondhand; used — the general term for any secondhand item, not limited to cars
- {中古品|ちゅうこひん}: secondhand goods — broader category covering all used items
